text.p: Metway Bank Ltd said operating conditions remained very competitive, with subdued market conditions in its key housing and business markets.
Metway earlier reported a 17 percent fall in net profit to A$41.69 million for the year to June 30, 1996.

"Operating conditions remained very competitive with lenders keenly focussed on both commercial and housing markets despite generally subdued activity in these areas," chairman Frank Haly said in a statement accompanying the annual results.
Haly said measures announced in last week's federal budget were expected to help stimulate confidence and activity in these core banking markets.

He said the profit result was sound in a year marked by unprecedented competition and a significant amount of staff time devoted to the merger proposals. Metway is to merge with Suncorp and Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC).
At 12.55 p.m (0255 GMT), Metway shares were steady at A$4.66 on slight volume.
